general.title: Mega Rail Deal Gets Unusual WH Meeting
general.summary: In a highly unusual gathering, White House officials met privately with a group of hedge fund investors betting on whether the $72 billion tie-up between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern will win approval from the Trump administration, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
general.summary: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.

general.title: Megadeals Defy Selloff, Head Toward Record
general.summary: Wall Street is taking a big step toward a record year for mergers and acquisitions as some of the world’s largest companies defy a tech-induced selloff in global stocks to pursue major takeovers. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Franklin Templeton's Araghi Sees AI Selloff as Market Reset
general.summary: Franklin Templeton portfolio manager Sara Araghi says the sharp tech selloff reflects an unwinding of earlier AI euphoria rather than a fundamental deterioration in demand. She discusses why AI infrastructure spending remains strong, the growing focus on proving returns from that investment and why she still views Anthropic’s record IPO as a success despite shares falling below their offering price. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles in ‘Sell First’ Mode
general.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at markets as the Nasdaq 100 touches bear-market territory with traders dumping tech shares. Plus, Nvidia shares also tumble after the return of CEO Jensen Huang, with the stock remaining down 35% from its October 6 peak; and Under Secretary of Energy Dario Gil joins to discuss AI's role in national security on the one-year anniversary of President Trump's Genesis Mission. (Source: Bloomberg)
